pages.title: Day 10: Superstructure / Day 13: Dark Ruins
pages.text: Superstructure is Day 10 of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995). The same tune plays on Day 13, Dark Ruins.

pages.title: The rocket nobody played
pages.text: BlueSky wanted its artists to draw tiles that could be used again on other levels of Vectorman. The first level built that way was Wicker Rocket, in which Vectorman rides a rocket made of wicker. Sega Retro says that the team cut it because they "could not make it fun", as designer Mark Lorenzen put it.
